description.text: One of the two fifth expansions of the Sword & Shield series, released together with Rapid Strike Master on 22 January 2021. They introduced two battle styles based on the two moves of Urshifu from The Isle of Armor, the first downloadable expansion of Pokémon Sword and Shield: Single Strike cards hit hard, and Rapid Strike cards act freely. Single Strike Master holds the Single Strike cards, led by Single Strike Urshifu VMAX, whose attack does 270 damage ignoring any effects on the opponent's Active Pokémon, with Tyranitar V and Single Strike Energy, which adds 20 damage; Flapple VMAX and Tapu Koko VMAX join them. Packs held five cards. The cards are numbered to 70, followed by full-art Super Rare Pokémon V and Supporters, some Pokémon V in a second version drawn as a full scene, rainbow Hyper Rare Pokémon VMAX and Supporters with a second Single Strike Urshifu VMAX drawn as a full scene, and gold Ultra Rare Houndoom, Exp. Share and Single Strike Energy. In English many of its cards came out in Battle Styles in March 2021.
